title: Import Lightroom brush tables from bounded ACR companions
source: rapidroom adaptation of skymanbp/autoshade brush-table decoder and measured flow law
notes: A shared read-only ACR object-store reader validates directories, object ranges/alignment, MD5 references and source identity, with per-file/object/import limits. The bounded Brotli brush-table decoder validates envelopes, exact output/input consumption and stroke/token grammar, including measured UUID prefixes and four-place hardness updates. Image-aware sidecar conversion appends inline strokes after table strokes, skips inactive records, resolves radius/flow/hardness state at each dab, and applies the measured flow odds law before density-scaled screen accumulation. Imported low-flow brushes accumulate in float until the final alpha bitmap; existing native flow brushes retain their rounding. Skipped groups are named in the import report; table-only refusals preserve existing edits and report the no-op. Native falloff and component-composition laws, erase encoding and local-strength calibration remain parity limits. AI corrections remain unsupported. Default renders require the frozen exact regression gate; human visual acceptance is pending.
